title: Install spaCR with pip
description: Create an isolated Python environment, install the public package, verify its dependencies, and launch the installed Qt application.
objectives: Create and activate a Python virtual environment.
Install spaCR and check its dependencies.
Launch the application and update the intended environment.
prerequisite: Install Python 3.12 and open a terminal. Use the activation command for your operating system and shell.

scenes.narration: Open a terminal and check your Python version. This walkthrough uses Python three point twelve. Keep spaCR in a dedicated virtual environment so its packages are easy to manage.
Create a virtual environment named dot venv with the command for your operating system. This creates a folder containing the Python environment you will use for spaCR.
Activate dot venv using the command for your shell. Windows PowerShell and Command Prompt have different activation commands; macOS and Linux usually use the shell command shown here.
Run python dash m pip dash dash version. Check that the displayed path belongs to dot venv. Use python dash m pip for the installation commands so pip uses this interpreter.
Upgrade pip, then install spacr. Wait for the scientific packages to finish downloading and installing. The current package includes the desktop components needed to open the application.
Check the installed spaCR version and package location with the displayed command. Save the version alongside your analysis notes.
Run python dash m pip check. If it reports conflicting requirements, resolve those conflicts before using the environment.
Run spacr-doctor to inspect the installation and see any missing optional features. Follow the suggested repair only for the formats or capabilities you need.
Launch spacr from the activated environment. On the first launch, follow the setup prompts and choose your preferences.
Home opens with the Core, Data, Tools and Assays categories. Continue to the Home tutorial to find a module, load example data and open a pipeline overview.
To update, close spaCR and activate this environment. Upgrade the package, then check its version and dependencies again. Keep the previous environment if you need it for an ongoing analysis.
